Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual fits exactly two more items of the same size, neither one nor three. This steers packing toward residuals that stay reusable for identical items, but the band may rarely occur and the base Best Fit term then dominates.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (25 if r - item >= 2 * item and r - item < 3 * item else 0) for r in bins]
```
